lines.text: The first week in Alupotha is done. The election is five weeks away. Uncle Sirisena's message is still circulating. Whether you stopped it, corrected it, shared it, or ignored it,  it is still out there.
The registration deadline is Week 4. The Elections Commission notice board has the correct information. Nandadasa Mahaththaya opens at 8:30.
Next week: The rumours start moving faster. Uncle Sirisena has found a voice note.
